title: NH-150E Road Realignment & Detailed Design
location: NH-150E, Chowdapur, Afzalpur & Ballurgi, Kalaburagi District, Karnataka
description: Highway realignment and detailed engineering design for three sections of NH-150E at Chowdapur Village (Km 35.935–39.255), Afzalpur Town (Km 58.220–62.290) and Ballurgi Village (Km 70.125–72.920), with a two-lane carriageway and paved shoulders under EPC mode. The design scope includes detailed drawings for the Chowdapur Vehicular Underpass (VUP).
